data.name: Resiliency
data.description: Once per day, you can gain %1 temporary hit points. Activating this ability is an immediate action that can only be performed when you are brought to below 0 hit points. This ability can be used to prevent yourself from dying. These temporary hit points last for 1 minute. If your hit points drop below 0 due to the loss of these temporary hit points, you fall unconscious and are dying as normal.|ResiliencyHitPoints
